Definition: properly, covered, i.e. dark; abstractly, obscurity, i.e. distress
BiblicalUsage: Muaph is darkness, obscurity, gloom — nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first He lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gloom is not the last word: the verse opens with 'nevertheless', and the light is coming behind it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
